s.en: Docker image and container command line interface

o.en: Specifies the location of the Docker client configuration files. The default is '~/.docker'.
Enable debug mode. Default is false.

The socket(s) to bind to in daemon mode specified using one or more tcp://host:port/path, unix:///path/to/socket, fd://* or fd://socketfd. If the tcp port is not specified, then it will default to either 2375 when --tls is off, or 2376 when --tls is on, or --tlsverify is specified.
Set the logging level. Default is info.
Use TLS; implied by --tlsverify. Default is false.
Trust certs signed only by this CA.
Use TLS and verify the remote (daemon: verify client, client: verify daemon). Default is false.
Print version information and quit. Default is false.
